name: omnisense/omnipost
description: Omnipost: the social networks' family. Publish: one contract for publishing a post - a reel, a picture, a carousel - through a network's API, reading one's own feed, and the capabilities each network imposes. Share: plain share links for visitors (Facebook, X, Pinterest, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon, Threads, WhatsApp, Telegram, Reddit, e-mail, copy, share sheet) - no network script, no cookie, one JSON for Twig, Blade and React. And its Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnipost/instagram: Instagram: the feed, pictures, carousels, reels and stories, the 60-day token's refresh
suggest.omnipost/youtube: YouTube: the channel's videos with a key, videos and Shorts uploaded through OAuth
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnipost\Bridge\Symfony\OmnipostBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnipost\Bridge\Symfony\OmnipostBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnipost\Bridge\Symfony\OmnipostBundle itself
